description: Renovate owns npm and pnpm. Dependabot owns GitHub Actions; see .github/dependabot.yml.
The CI gate in .github/workflows/ci.yml judges every pull request this bot opens, so grouping trades pull-request count against the width of a failure.
Schedules have no timezone and therefore read as UTC.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Dependabot owns this manager. Two bots on one ecosystem duplicate every pull request.
The minor and patch tail for runtime dependencies, as one pull request.
The minor and patch tail for build and test tooling, as one pull request.
React and its type packages must move together, because a mismatched @types/react breaks check-types across all five workspaces.
The Tailwind packages share one version line across admin, places, and ui.

Vitest, its browser packages, and Playwright share a release train. packages/ui pins @vitest/browser, @vitest/browser-playwright, and playwright exactly, and the browser job installs Chromium against them, so a partial bump breaks test:browser.
Every major waits for a click on the dependency dashboard, so each one lands on its own branch with its own gate run.

pnpm-workspace.yaml patches @floating-ui/react at an exact version. A bump invalidates the patch key, and re-applying the patch needs a person: overlay-activity-hold.test.tsx must pass again and tms-ui must take the identical copy.
hlidskjalf is first-party. pnpm-workspace.yaml already exempts its releases from the install cooldown, so the bot waits for nothing either.
